feature.label: MyDebug HotReload
feature.description: Save a Java file and see the change in the running application instantly, without a restart. A bundled agent reloads changed classes in Run and Debug and refreshes Spring (endpoints, injected fields, new beans) and MyBatis (mapper XML). On JetBrains Runtime, adding or removing methods and fields reloads too.
